rules.name: Payment implies PCI-DSS
then_add: The system shall comply with PCI-DSS requirements for payment processing
The system shall encrypt payment data in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher
The system shall not store CVV numbers after authorization

rules.name: User data implies GDPR
then_add: The system shall comply with GDPR data protection requirements
The system shall provide data export functionality
The system shall support account deletion and data erasure

rules.name: Real-time tracking implies location
then_add: The system shall request location permissions from users
The system shall handle GPS signal loss gracefully
The system shall optimize battery usage for location updates

rules.name: Mobile app implies push notifications
then_add: The system shall support push notifications for order updates
The system shall handle offline mode gracefully

rules.name: Authentication implies security
then_add: The system shall implement rate limiting for login attempts
The system shall support password reset functionality
The system shall log all authentication attempts
